children: Aave has opened the waitlist for its new consumer app at aave.com/app. The app is designed for DeFi savings and shows earning balances, withdrawals, deposits, and future-projection simulations so users can model how their positions may grow over time.

The waitlist gives Aave a retail distribution step ahead of broader availability. A consumer-facing interface with balance tracking and yield projections lowers the practical barrier for users who want savings-style exposure without navigating the protocol directly. Signups also give the team an early measure of demand before a full launch. Actual adoption remains to be seen, since waitlist interest does not guarantee active usage once the app is generally available.

title: Aave: App Waitlist Opens for DeFi Savings App - 07 Sep 2026
